positive_arm.status: falsifiable branch; any count, identity, mission, shortage, or grammar deviation is NO_GO, not a revised outcome fit

first_cycle_display_hypotheses.meaning: literal time hypotheses for this branch, not a seed invariance law; failure to observe any is NO_GO

later_cycles.failure_time: finite observed f_j strictly within each scheduled mission [20,22) or [32,34); values are not inherited from E05
later_cycles.aborted_return: a_j from native events, with 0<=a_j-f_j<=0.5 and a_j<=scheduled_start+2; parent capped-return pattern a_j=min(f_j+0.5,scheduled_start+2) is an explicit strict hypothesis
later_cycles.demand_issue: at a_j, exactly one usable stock item issued: repaired failed physical ID from prior cycle
later_cycles.system_REMOVE_end_and_item_DIRP_start: a_j+1/6 hour, with exact causal ordering and native display precision
later_cycles.system_REPLACE_end_and_ready: a_j+1/2 hour; no item repair/stock timing may be substituted for aircraft ready
later_cycles.item_DIRP_end_and_restock: item_DIRP_start+1.5 hours, for the same failed physical ID; later demand follows prior restock

line_grammar.source: ordered E05 parent line descriptors, not copied parent numeric times or report values
line_grammar.rule: all physical lines including 36 untimed continuations must match the complete parent event-kind/order grammar, allowing only explicitly declared time/failure-clock/complexity numeric tokens and 1.0-to-1.5 DIRP planned-duration/completion/stock times; no extra change announcement, warning, failure, repair, stock, or mission line; no missing/reordered line
line_grammar.full_grammar_requirement: before prelaunch a separate sealed checker must enumerate every one of the 222 line patterns, bind every variable to the causal ledger, and reject every unknown line; this prospective document alone is not a checker
line_grammar.bounded_random_clock: all random clock/complexity tokens finite, source-bound and ordered; later draws may differ from accepted E05; no assumed RNG identity

physical_conservation.each_cycle: on_hand1 -> issue existing ID -> on_hand0 -> removed failed ID starts DIRP -> same ID completes -> on_hand1; no duplicate, lost or spontaneously created ID
physical_conservation.issue_chain: 0, then repaired1, then repaired2; failed3 returns before horizon
physical_conservation.stock_report_PNB_warning: PNB is an aggregate selected-report field and does not prove physical stock on hand; only ordered stock events establish this ledger

time_precision.printed_decimal: for a time displayed with p decimal digits, derive a closed rounding interval of half a last printed unit around that display; source-scheduled integer/half-hour times are exact
time_precision.bin_uniqueness: every stochastic event and derived completion used for a half-hour count must have its whole display interval inside one bin; boundary crossing is NO_GO, except source-exact scheduled rational boundaries with separately frozen parent representation
time_precision.comparison: state occupancy is computed as an interval over display-time uncertainty, expanded only by two binary32 ULPs at the expected magnitude; exact integer, string and null fields do not use tolerance
time_precision.no_fit: do not choose alternate internal times from report values or stretch tolerances after observation
